sourceDecision.evidenceClass: Read-only operator view for GPP §11 and guard efficacy (BI-FEDD8F45), composed from report-kit StatCard, DataTable and StatusBadge in the existing ops shell. The lead band states the period, what was observed and which measures are unknown, and marks the owner-first next action (none needed). Four StatCards; both tables sit behind collapsed disclosure; every value shows numerator of denominator and its unit; unknown renders as a warning badge, never zero or success. No inputs, filters or write controls. Rejected: MCP-only (operator must ask an agent), a section on /ops/dev-loop (mixes coordination with efficacy), a charted dashboard (cognitive load without new information).
